Santa Eugenia — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Santa Eugenia has substantial, recent and serious documented coverage: a clan-related shooting reported by ABC, a wave of pharmacy robberies in August 2025, vandalism against Mercado de Santa Eugenia shops in October 2025, and a stabbing/robbery of a 25-year-old man's shoes in October 2025. Older coverage documents an organised drug-trafficking group operating in the barrio (detected 2010, arrests reported 2018) and a historic robbery gang (1996), alongside a 2011 resident complaint about insecurity following a violent incident. The combination of very recent violent crime (shooting, stabbing) with a longer documented pattern supports a serious rating. Sources checked: ABC (clan shooting, recent); El Confidencial, 15 Aug 2025 (pharmacy robbery wave); Telemadrid, Oct 2025 (market vandalism); Telemadrid, Oct 2025 (stabbing/shoe robbery); Telemadrid, 23 Aug 2018 (organised drug-trafficking group); Europa Press, 5 Sept 2011 (resident insecurity complaint).
